connector.name: Mnemolog MCP
connector.registryDescription: Hosted MCP memory and agent control plane for durable conversations, jobs, and operations.
connector.summary: Hosted at mnemolog.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace dev.pages.mnemolog. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token for Mnemolog (user JWT or mna_* token)
